clips.label: Garden journey — gentle ending
clips.details:
Sixteen seconds, preserving the complete pomegranate opening. The view travels toward a blue ring and a garden of red orchids and floating stairs. The final noise ramp falls to 0.30, and the late surfaces become flatter. Some ghosting remains during major changes.

Krea Turbo generates the opening and every new painting. Each repaint starts from the warped previous painting, using three Euler intervals and CFG1. Time-based Lanczos transforms control spatial motion. RIFE 4.25 fills the gaps and never feeds back into generation. These editions preserve every painting and run 1.5 times faster than the original timeline: 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second, seven intermediate frames per pair.
